prompt_en: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic vertical action photograph of a shirtless muscular man climbing a jagged icy mountain cliff during a ferocious blizzard, shot from a dramatic wide-angle perspective as if from a camera attached near the climbing rope. The man is in the lower foreground, leaning upward with intense survival energy, one hand gripping a thick rope that runs toward the viewer and the other hand holding a battered ice axe. He wears only torn, dark grey denim pants with ripped knees; his bare torso is heavily muscled, dirty, scratched, wet, and dusted with snow and frost. Behind and above him, an enormous snow leopard leaps down from the cliff face in mid-attack, mouth open snarling, blue-gray eyes focused on the climber, one front paw extended with claws visible. The scene is set in a steep Himalayan-style gorge with dark rocky walls, snow-covered ridges, icy mist, wind-blown powder, and dense diagonal snowfall. Use cold blue-gray color grading, high contrast, gritty textures, realistic fur detail, frozen skin texture, motion blur in the snow, and dramatic cinematic lighting. Keep the composition tense and dynamic: the climber occupies the lower left/center foreground, the rope creates strong depth toward the bottom right, and the attacking animal dominates the upper right background. No text, no watermark, no extra people, no modern climbing gear besides the rope and ice axe.\

prompt_en: Create a cinematic fashion editorial contact sheet made of exactly 6 panels arranged in a 3-column by 2-row grid, separated by thin dark dividers, on a wide 16:9 canvas. The subject is a poised female fashion model wearing a deep sapphire blue floor-length satin evening gown with elegant draping, a sleeveless high neckline, fitted waist, and long flowing skirt. The setting in every panel is an icy crystal palace with translucent arched walls, giant quartz-like crystal formations, cool blue-white mist, glossy reflective ice floors, and soft ethereal lighting. Panel 1, top left: full-body front view of the model standing centered in the distant crystal hall, dress falling straight to the floor with a small train reflection. Panel 2, top center: full-body three-quarter fashion pose, one hand on hip, gown pooling at the feet, face covered by a small neutral gray rectangular privacy block. Panel 3, top right: close-up portrait crop from shoulders to top of head, showing slick dark hair, blue dress neckline, dangling silver earrings, and a large neutral gray rectangular block obscuring the face. Panel 4, bottom left: overhead top-down shot of the model seated or crouched in the center of a dramatic circular fan of the blue gown, surrounded by radiating ice crystals, face covered by a small gray block. Outfits should be stylish casual for a New York trip, including elements like a white tank top, jeans, knitwear, light jacket, sunglasses, crossbody bag, and sneakers. Not too perfect, not like a commercial campaign. The photos should be authentic, with a sense of daily life and travel memories. Nine-Grid Content: 1. Top Left: Selfie near the Statue of Liberty. Holding a phone, background shows the Statue of Liberty and the sea. Smiling happily, hair slightly wind-blown, slightly overexposed for an authentic tourist selfie look. 2. Top Middle: Times Square at night. Background with neon lights, billboards, crowds, and streets. The person is walking and turning back to the camera with a smile; slight motion blur as if captured by a friend. 3. Top Right: Central Park. Sitting on a bench or grass, relaxed posture, hand on chin or hair, natural expression. Background with trees and sunlight, with slight phone compression quality. 4. Middle Left: New York street pizza shop or hot dog stand. Holding a slice of pizza or street snack, smiling and ready to eat with a vivid, infectious expression. Walking and turning back to smile, hair wind-blown, slight candid blur, composition slightly off-center but subject clearly visible. 8. Bottom Middle: Empire State Building or high-rise observation deck. Selfie or friend-shot with the NYC skyline. Posing with a peace sign, pout, or natural gaze. Authentic tourist photo vibe. 9. Bottom Right: Street photography in SoHo or DUMBO. Walking along the street in stylish casual wear, with sunglasses or a bag, turning back to smile. Background with red brick buildings, cafes, or street signs. Expression and Pose Requirements: Avoid looking at the camera or smiling in every photo. prompt_en:
Goal: Create a premium editorial fashion photo collage for a luxury magazine spread titled VOGUE with the subtitle BANGKOK NIGHTS, featuring a glamorous young Asian businesswoman in a black satin blazer dress during an upscale city nightlife evening.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 portrait collage, approximately 768 x 1152 px, with thin black gutters between panels and a sophisticated black, white, neon, and wet-asphalt color palette. Use high-end editorial photography, cinematic night lighting, shallow depth of field, glossy reflections, and luxury magazine styling.

Layout: Use exactly 6 discrete panels arranged as a modern asymmetrical magazine grid:
1. Top-left panel: black-and-white close-up portrait of the woman from shoulders up, long wavy dark hair, black blazer, blurred bokeh city lights behind her; place a soft rectangular face-obscuring blur over the central face area.
2. Top-right large panel: full-body fashion portrait on a rainy neon-lit Bangkok street at night, woman walking confidently in a black wrap blazer dress with a thigh-high slit, black high-heel sandals, wet pavement reflecting red and blue signs, taxis and storefront signs in the background; add a small soft rectangular face blur.
3. Middle-left panel: rooftop cocktail table with exactly 3 visible objects: one coupe cocktail glass, one rocks glass cocktail with citrus garnish, and one lit candle in a patterned glass holder; Bangkok skyline bokeh in the distance.
4. Bottom-left panel: dramatic night cityscape with tall illuminated skyscrapers, elevated highway, modern bridge/rail structure, and long-exposure light trails from traffic.
5. Middle-right panel: seated or leaning close portrait of the same woman in a deep black satin blazer, warm out-of-focus city lights behind her, a drink glass partially visible at the right edge; add a soft rectangular face-obscuring blur.
6. Bottom-right panel: solid black title card with large elegant white serif text \
